article.headline: Mukeba scores 23, Oakland beats Green Bay 87-84 in OT
article.description: — Allen David Mukeba Jr.'s 23 points helped Oakland defeat Green Bay 87-84 in overtime on Saturday.
article.linkText: Mukeba scores 23, Oakland beats Green Bay 87-84 in OT
article.story: GREEN BAY, Wis. -- — Allen David Mukeba Jr.'s 23 points helped Oakland defeat Green Bay 87-84 in overtime on Saturday. Mukeba had 11 rebounds for the Golden Grizzlies (14-17, 11-9 Horizon League). D.Q. Cole scored 21 points while going 6 of 10 from the floor, including 4 for 7 from 3-point range, and 5 for 6 from the line and added five rebounds and seven assists. Tuburu Niavalurua shot 5 of 11 from the field and 4 for 8 from the line to finish with 14 points, while adding seven rebounds. Marcus Hall led the Phoenix (4-27, 2-18) in scoring, finishing with 25 points. Jeremiah Johnson added 18 points for Green Bay. Foster Wonders had 12 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
